entities.summary: Colin Smith is a Canadian professional ice hockey player currently under contract with Eispiraten Crimmitschau of the DEL2. Smith played in the National Hockey League (NHL) and was selected by the Colorado Avalanche in the 7th round of the 2012 NHL Entry Draft.
